findings.title: An allow rule approves every shell command
findings.why: Any command the agent decides to run, including deleting files or sending data out, runs without a prompt.
findings.fix: Replace it with the specific commands you use, such as "Bash(npm run test)" or "Bash(git diff *)".

findings.title: The repository approves its own MCP servers
findings.why: Once you trust the folder, every server in .mcp.json starts without a prompt, including ones added in a later commit.
findings.fix: Remove the key and approve servers one by one, or list them in enabledMcpjsonServers in your local settings.

findings.title: A hook downloads code and runs it
findings.why: This hook in a repository file downloads a script and pipes it into a shell. Whoever controls that address decides what runs on your machine, and it can change at any time without the config changing.
findings.fix: Download and review the script, commit it to the repository or your home folder, and run the local copy.

findings.title: A value of TICKETS_API_TOKEN is stored in plain text in an MCP server's env
findings.why: Anyone who can read this file, or a backup or dotfiles repo that copies it, gets the credential.
findings.fix: Rotate the key and reference it instead, for example ${API_KEY}, so the value stays in your environment.

findings.title: Codex runs anything, anywhere, without asking
findings.why: Commands run with full disk and network access and Codex never stops to ask.

findings.title: A secrets file in this project isn't blocked from the agent
findings.why: Claude Code can read this file without asking, and anything it reads can end up in a prompt, a log or a tool call.
findings.fix: Add "Read(./.env)" to permissions.deny in .claude/settings.json, or "Read(**/.env)" to cover every copy.

findings.title: MCP server "browser" runs an unpinned package
findings.why: Each launch fetches whatever version is newest. If the package or its publisher account is compromised, the next start runs the new code with your agent's access.
findings.fix: Pin an exact version, for example npx demo-browser-mcp@1.2.3.

findings.title: MCP server "tickets" changed since the baseline
findings.why: Its command, arguments, URL or environment differ from what you recorded, so it may now run different code or connect somewhere else.
findings.fix: Check the change (git log or diff the file). If you made it, re-record the baseline with --reset-baseline.

findings.title: An allow rule approves "npx" with any arguments
findings.why: "npx" can run arbitrary code, reach the network or delete files, so allowing it with any arguments is close to allowing every command.
findings.fix: Allow the exact invocations you need, for example "Bash(npx ...)" with fixed arguments.

findings.title: The agent can fetch any web address without asking
findings.why: A prompt injected into a page or file can make the agent send data to any site, with no prompt to stop it.
